slides.title: Jeep put IFS on a Wrangler.
slides.body: The Scrambler SRT concept is the first Wrangler ever without a solid front axle. Don’t panic.

slides.title: The Bronco had a point.
slides.body: V8, long-travel IFS, trophy-truck rear axle. This is Jeep’s answer to fast desert trucks, not a new Rubicon.

slides.credit: JL Unlimited Rubicon · NPS / Emily Hassell, public domain
slides.title: For rocks, nothing changes.
slides.body: Solid axles still win on ledges, lifts and 37s. For fast dirt and highway miles, IFS wins.
slides.tag: Wrangler vs Bronco on the site

end.title: IFS vs solid axle, from someone who’s owned both.
end.body: My full take, and what it means for JL and Bronco buyers.
